operations.details: Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium GroundWaterML 2 (GWML2) page.
Groundwater-domain data separated from ground-surface DTM.
Hydrogeologic encoding not promoted to parcel terrain accuracy.
Surface elevation source and vertical uncertainty remain required.
Verified official Open Geospatial Consortium EO Dataset Metadata GeoJSON(-LD) page.
EO dataset metadata separated from source pixel values.
Granule metadata encoding not promoted to terrain measurement accuracy.
Actual observation bytes and quality lineage remain required.
Both OGC GWML2 and OGC EO GeoJSON URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No service/model/encoding value substituted for parcel terrain measurement without independent lineage.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
